description: An object with a `[Symbol.iterator]()` method. Consumed by `for...of`, spread and `Array.from`.
An object with `next()` returning `{ done, value }` results.
The object returned by a `function*`: yields `T`, returns `TReturn`, accepts `TNext` through `next()`.
Delegates to another iterable, yielding each of its values.
ES2025 lazy `map`, `filter`, `take`, `drop`, `toArray`… on built-in iterators, typed via `IteratorObject`.
